work_packages.title: Make main green and the handoff true
work_packages.scope: Six clippy::map_unwrap_or errors in birdnet-core (CI run 43311161060), the mutation workflow's config check, and the stale header and section 6 of docs/HANDOFF.md. Source: 08-existing-backlog-reconciled.md.

work_packages.title: A second classifier that cannot run must not stop detection
work_packages.scope: Drop the unusable extra classifier, keep the primary, say so on the page and in --doctor.

work_packages.title: Non-bird classes, the human-sound rule and the range filter across classifiers
work_packages.scope: One list of non-bird and human classes per vocabulary; the location filter applied to every classifier's species.

work_packages.title: A ledger of everything the filters discard
work_packages.scope: Count every discard by reason, keep out-of-range detections in the quarantine with the reason the UI already has, persist the counters.

work_packages.title: Source identity and fairness between sources
work_packages.scope: Shed fairly across sources; key comments and quarantine by source; duplicate-device guard; channel selection; removed sources stay removed.

work_packages.title: Effort that is true, hourly and per source, and used as the denominator
work_packages.scope: Credit analysed audio, not uptime; hourly resolution; per-source rates; every rate, average and anomaly reads it.

work_packages.title: One bird heard by several sources is one event
work_packages.scope: Non-destructive event grouping across sources; analytics, DuckDB copy, BirdWeather and notifications count events and carry the source. Maintainer decision 1 and 2 first.

work_packages.title: Segment seams, timing and capacity
work_packages.scope: Calls across segment boundaries, dropped tails, timestamp precision, RTSP delay, limits that scale with the number of sources. Maintainer decision 6 first.

work_packages.title: Thresholds, score scales and the signal path
work_packages.scope: A bar per classifier scale; dynamic thresholds that cannot feed themselves; the shared model cut; the night list; the capture high-pass in the parity study.

work_packages.title: A validation protocol and honest confidence wording
work_packages.scope: Reviewer identity kept, verdict history, blind random-sample review with intervals, exports of verified sets, no certainty claims from an uncalibrated score.

work_packages.title: Measured accuracy: a ground-truth harness on both architectures
work_packages.scope: Precision and recall on annotated recordings with the station's filters on; model output checked on aarch64; timings on a Pi.

work_packages.title: Provenance, exports and the deployment record
work_packages.scope: Per-row model attribution, run records that hold the whole configuration, clock trust, stable ids, methods-ready exports, calibrated or relabelled sound levels.

work_packages.title: Re-analysis and batch ingest of recorder cards
work_packages.scope: Re-run kept audio under another model or threshold as a new versioned run; accept recorder filenames.

work_packages.title: Analytics that are statistics, not metaphors
work_packages.scope: Null models and multiple-comparison control for the behavioural views; sun-relative dawn analyses; Jaccard for companions.

work_packages.title: A first run that tells the truth in plain words
work_packages.scope: Silent or clipping microphone, missing location, wrong time zone and stale clock each shown on the first screen; one notification default; plain wording.

work_packages.title: Install, update and recovery without a terminal
work_packages.scope: Flashable image (maintainer decision 5), in-app update that the unit's sandbox allows, safe behaviour on a BirdNET-Pi host, stable device names in Docker.

work_packages.title: Navigation, naming and stale words
work_packages.scope: One name per thing, orphaned routes removed or linked, a Birder and a Researcher depth, documentation that matches the code.

work_packages.title: One chart system, accessible and linkable, then the new graphics
work_packages.scope: Shared helpers and scales, table alternatives, ranges in the URL, localised numbers and times, then the charts the data supports.

items.title: Segment boundaries are hard edges — calls are split, edge chunks filtered harder, and a non-multiple segment length discards audio
items.evidence: d011dbc: --doctor has a 'Segment length' check (always Warn) for audio never analysed and for a last window padded with silence, with the amount and the nearest segment length or overlap that avoids it; the defaults raise nothing. pipeline.rs exposes the walk as chunk_layout and process_file runs through it. Red against the old doctor: '10 s raised nothing', 'overlap 1.5'. Seam measurement with the real V2.4 model (2026-11-25, one 1.2 s magpie call, 300 positions, not committed): at overlap 0 per-file and continuous analysis agree at every position; with overlap 1.5 and 2.0 a near-threshold call is lost at 18 and 15 of 62 seam positions per file against 12 and 6 continuous. Recorded in decisions-2026-11-25.md section 3. Remains: the doctor does not read values saved only on the settings page (N26-03).
